verdict.rationale: Baseten publishes Truss, its first-party model packaging and deployment tool, as a public GitHub repository (basetenlabs/truss), so part of the product's tooling source is readable. However, no evidence states Truss's license, and nothing shows the core hosted platform (Model APIs, MCM, training) is source-available. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license for Truss, source availability for the core platform, and independent corroboration of the licensing terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Package model code, weights, and dependencies with a model server that behaves the same in development and production.
Package your model's serving logic in Python, launch training jobs, and deploy to production—Truss handles containerization, dependency management, and GPU configuration.
